cards.title: Plane 1 — Ingress & Triggers (Web UI · Cron · Ext MCP)
items: Web UI (apps/web): React + Vite streaming chat, Role Switcher, SQL/citation drawer, Vega-Lite/Plotly viewer, HITL plan editor, Dictionary admin; sanitized Markdown + CSP (img-src 'self' data:); imports @shared/contracts only
Scheduled & CLI (UC-10): Daily 07:00 node-cron or pnpm alert:run --manual scans subscribed slices with per-slice checkpointing so one failed slice never aborts remaining subscriptions
External MCP Clients (UC-09): MCP Inspector / scripts/externalClient.ts connect over Streamable HTTP using per-client scoped Bearer tokens (never data:sensitive) and cannot bypass the 7-stage gateway

cards.title: Plane 2 — Host & Session Boundary (apps/api)
items: API Host & SSE: Express gateway mints threadId/runId (X-Run-Id), maps Role Switcher personas to role Bearer tokens (X-User-Id / X-Role-Scope are correlation-only), streams SSE progress, exposes /api/ask, /api/runs/:runId/resume, /api/semantic/reindex
Concurrency & Retention: Per-threadId single-flight lock returns 409 Conflict on concurrent runs; stale checkpointId rejected on HITL resume; checkpoints pruned after 30d (HITL-pending expired at 7d)
Persistence Ports: Injects PostgresSaver (langgraph.*) and AppStateStore (app_state.alert_history) using dedicated harness_state DB role with zero privileges on public.* business tables

cards.title: Plane 3A — Governance, Skills & Semantic RAG (gov_ctx)
items: Budget Circuit Breaker: Checks maxLlmCalls, maxTokens, runDeadlineMs before every LLM/MCP call; on trip, routes to a deterministic terminal template with zero extra LLM calls (status: error + budget_exceeded caveat)

Declarative Skill Loader: loadSkill() loads skills/*/SKILL.md (text-to-sql, root-cause-analysis, anomaly-alert, pii-safe-query), validates 6 mandatory sections, emits skill_call spans; zero runnable scripts or credentials

Intent & Full-Slot Gate (UC-01/02): Splits requestedMetrics vs schemaEntities; short-circuits uncovered KPIs/entities to cannot_answer (0 SQL); definition_lookup skips SQL; merges multi-turn AnalysisState deltas

3-Way Hybrid RAG (UC-02): RRF (k=60) fuses pgvector HNSW, hot-reloaded Vietnamese/ASCII BM25, and exact alias match (w=1.5), plus auto join_rule graph expansion, enumValues anchors, SHA-256 incremental indexing, and live-DB semantic:verify

cards.title: Plane 3B — Execution, RCA & Anomaly Loops (exec_loops)
items: ValidatedQueryExecutor: Shared SQL loop — candidate union (schemaEntities ∪ semanticChunks.tables) → selective describe_table → grounded SQL proposal → local sqlGuard ('Did you mean?' + 1 bridge-table expand) + LocalQuerySafetyGate (anti-fanout, LIMIT ≤200, large-table filter) → explain_query cost gate → MCP run_query → ≤3 repairs + 1-pass zero-row probe

Clarify-Then-Query & HITL: Halts with needs_clarification (≤2 turns) on ambiguous KPIs or unfiltered ≥1M-row scans; UC-05 calls interrupt('review_analysis_plan') and resumes via Command({resume}) with asOf snapshot freshness bounds

Hierarchical RCA (UC-05): validate_baseline halts on false_premise; create_plan builds MECE tree (Region→Channel→Category→Product, Orders×AOV); prunes branches <30% share, depth ≤4, queries ≤20; additivity-aware (rate/mix, LMDI-I, Simpson's guard)

Anomaly Detector (UC-10): Pure-code 28d 5–95% trimmed z-score + WoW% + min_support ≥15 orders/day (weekday seasonality, holiday calendar, BH FDR q=0.05); triggers 1–2 dim LLM drill-down only on breached slices

cards.title: Plane 3C — Pre-Response K7 Verification Gates (k7_gates)
items: CitationValidator (UC-02): Enforces 100% catalog match for every cited metric/table/column/event ID retrieved in the turn and deterministically prepends -- @citations: to SQL (≤2 repairs)
Headless render_chart (UC-03): Compiles Vega-Lite/Plotly JSON specs headlessly with zero code execution and checks every encoded field exists in RunQueryOutput.columns (≤2 repairs)

Numeric, Truncation & Causal Verifier (UC-03): Checks claims against evidence and transient ≤1,000-row RAM buffer within ≤1% tolerance, verifies sign polarity, blocks unverified totals on truncated: true, regenerates once then strips with visible caveat

Attribution & Alert Dispatch (UC-05/10): Verifies RCA attribution sums within ≤5% of total delta; send_alert enforces allowlists, 10s timeout, ≤3 retries, and writes 24h dedup fingerprints to alert_history only post-send

cards.title: Plane 4 — Bounded LLM Proposal Plane (3 Zod Profiles)
items: Profile 1 — Intent & Plan LLM: Proposes structured intent (requestedMetrics, schemaEntities, dimensions, filters, timeRange), ambiguity checks, and UC-05 MECE decomposition trees; zero DB credentials or execution authority

Profile 2 — SQL Proposer LLM: Generates a single SELECT/WITH from selectively described schemas, semanticChunks, join_rule CTE templates, and enumValues anchors (SemanticQueryCompiler for governed KPIs planned in Wave 3)
Profile 3 — Tool-Free Synthesizer: Drafts SQLAnswer, InsightReport, RootCauseAnswer, and AnomalyAlert from ≤50-row resultPreview wrapped in escaped <untrusted_data> tags with ZERO tools bound
Output-Format Isolation: Malformed JSON/Zod or provider 5xx gets ≤1 re-ask on the same profile without consuming a ValidatedQueryExecutor SQL repair attempt

cards.title: Plane 5A — MCP Gateway (packages/mcp-server · UC-09)
items: Sole DB Gateway: Exposes 5 DB tools (list_tables, describe_table, explain_query, run_query, sample_rows n≤5), search_semantic_layer, and 2 resources (semantic://data-dictionary, semantic://metrics) over Streamable HTTP

Stages 1–4 (Auth & Guard): (1) Constant-time Bearer auth via mcp_clients.yaml (signed short-lived principal JWT in Wave 2) → (2) Scope check (schema:read, data:read, data:sensitive) → (3) Zod bounds (maxRows ≤1000) → (4) pgsql-parser full-AST sqlGuard

Stages 5–7 (Policy, Exec & Audit): (5) AccessPolicy (resolveColumns AST masking + row-scope; fail-closed on WHERE/aggregate/complex CTE sensitive refs) → (6) agent_ro BEGIN READ ONLY + 30s timeout + pg-cursor (maxRows+1) → (7) Regex PII post-scan + JSONL audit

Error Routing Matrix: Hard security codes (FORBIDDEN_*, SENSITIVE_COLUMN_DENIED, SCOPE_DENIED) abort on Attempt 1 (repairable: false); SQL/schema errors (INVALID_SQL, UNKNOWN_TABLE, SQL_EXECUTION_ERROR) feed sanitized hints to ≤3 repairs

cards.title: Plane 5B — PostgreSQL 16, 4-Tier Memory & Redacted Sinks
items: 4 Isolated DB Roles: owner (offline pnpm data:load DDL/seed only), agent_ro (MCP SELECT-only + engine RLS in Wave 2), indexer (RAG CLI writes semantic.semantic_chunks), harness_state (API writes langgraph.* & app_state.*, zero public.* grants)

4-Tier Memory: Tier 1 transient ≤1,000-row RAM validation buffer; Tier 2 PostgresSaver checkpoints (langgraph.*); Tier 3 app_state.alert_history + append-only redacted JSONL (mcp_audit.jsonl, traces/*.jsonl, failed_alerts_queue.jsonl) + LangSmith; Tier 4 semantic.semantic_chunks (pgvector HNSW + RAM BM25)
Olist VN Dataset: public.* holds ≥8 tables (order_items ≥1M rows), fake vi_VN PII (always redacted in outputs/traces), and hidden seeded RCA, anomaly, and prompt-injection scenarios

cards.title: Contracts (@shared/contracts), Boundaries & Hardening
items: Frozen Contracts (v1.0.0): tools.ts, errors.ts (12 codes, retryable vs repairable), answers.ts, trace.ts, semantic.ts, benchmark.ts — camelCase Zod schemas depending on zod only; docs/mcp_interface.md generated via pnpm docs:interface

ESLint Package Boundaries: agent, access-policy, and web cannot import pg/pg-cursor or mcp-server/src/**; web imports @shared/contracts only; access-policy is pure AST/regex with zero DB or network I/O

5 Invariants & 3 Hardening Waves: Single DB gateway, 4-layer defense-in-depth, escaped untrusted_data + zero-tool synthesis, K7 pre-response verification, credential-bound identity; Waves W1–W3 track RLS, signed principal tokens, SemanticQueryCompiler, and FDR/seasonality
